title: The Neighbour: ricercar a 4 on the pipe organ (Bach version)
about: The four voices on the Norrfjärden Church organ (audio/organ), one division each so the lines stay apart in colour and position: soprano on the Hauptwerck, alto on the Oberwerck, tenor on the Rückpositief, bass on the Pedal (16'+8' as its floor). In the arioso the soprano takes the Rückpositief Sesquialtera as a solo and the tenor moves to a soft Hauptwerck flute; both return at 35. Dynamics are terraced: the registration changes only at section and entry joins, each division at a point where its own voice attacks (so no stop is drawn under a held key), never as a hairpin. Principal chorus built 8', 8'+4', 8'+4'+2' through the fugue; plenum with pedal reeds for Climax I (26:3), Climax II (52:1, manual reeds added at the fff peak 53:1) and the apotheosis peak (59:1, the tune on the Hauptwerck plenum with Trommeten over the answer in the pedal reeds); flutes for the subito-piano spans (arioso, fuga inversa, the dominant pedal) and the coda. The Oberwerck's own plenum draws the Spitzquinten 1 1/2', whose recorded pipes beat (audio/organ/README.md, Limits), so the alto's chorus registrations are custom lists without it. Rendered by render.sh in this folder: orchestrate.py (plan.json, this spec; integrity check), articulate.py (baroque touch), render_organ.py with the church acoustic, qa_organ.py.
